mapper.select: SELECT category_id, category_name, category_status FROM categories ORDER BY category_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subjects WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND category_status = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT subject_id, category_id, subject_name, subject_status, usage_count,created_at FROM subjects ORDER BY category_id, subject_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subjects (subject_id, category_id, subject_name, subject_status,created_at) VALUES (subjects_seq.NEXTVAL, #{category_id}, #{subject_name},'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_sessions WHERE created_at >= #{fromDate} AND created_at < #{toDateExclusive}) AS generated_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_num) FROM quiz_sessions WHERE created_at >= #{fromDate} AND created_at < #{toDateExclusive}) AS participant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selfstudy_results WHERE submitted_at >= #{fromDate} AND submitted_at < #{toDateExclusive}) AS submitted_count, NVL((SELECT AVG(selfstudy_total_score) FROM selfstudy_results WHERE submitted_at >= #{fromDate} AND submitted_at < #{toDateExclusive}), 0) AS average_score FROM dual

SELECT TO_CHAR(activity_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS usage_date, SUM(generated_count) AS generated_count, SUM(submitted_count) AS submitted_count FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(created_at) AS activity_date, COUNT(*) AS generated_count, 0 AS submitted_count FROM quiz_sessions WHERE created_at >= #{fromDate} AND created_at < #{toDateExclusive} GROUP BY TRUNC(created_at) UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(submitted_at) AS activity_date, 0 AS generated_count, COUNT(*) AS submitted_count FROM selfstudy_results WHERE submitted_at >= #{fromDate} AND submitted_at < #{toDateExclusive} GROUP BY TRUNC(submitted_at) ) GROUP BY activity_date ORDER BY activity_date

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS generated_count FROM quiz_sessions qs JOIN subjects s ON s.subject_id = qs.subject_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE qs.created_at >= #{fromDate} AND qs.created_at < #{toDateExclusive} GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY generated_count DESC, c.category_name

SELECT s.subject_id, s.subject_name, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS generated_count FROM quiz_sessions qs JOIN subjects s ON s.subject_id = qs.subject_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE qs.created_at >= #{fromDate} AND qs.created_at < #{toDateExclusive} GROUP BY s.subject_id, s.subject_name, c.category_name ORDER BY generated_count DESC, c.category_name, s.subject_name FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
